findings.control: threat mapping: adversary technique for planted exposure
findings.rationale: The planted public-read bucket is exactly the condition ATT&CK T1530 (Data from Cloud Storage) exploits: an adversary reads cloud-stored objects without authenticating.
findings.traces_to: extension/range/tf_s3_public_access/input/main.tf public-read ACL mapped to ATT&CK technique T1530

findings.control: threat mapping: adversary technique for planted exposure
findings.rationale: The planted disabled management trail is the condition ATT&CK sub-technique T1562.008 (Disable or Modify Cloud Logs) leaves behind: control-plane actions leave no durable record.
findings.traces_to: extension/range/tf_cloudtrail_disabled/input/main.tf disabled trail mapped to ATT&CK sub-technique T1562.008

findings.control: threat mapping: adversary technique for planted exposure
findings.rationale: The planted wildcard identity policy is what makes ATT&CK T1078 (Valid Accounts) devastating here: any compromised account operates with no action or resource boundary.
